title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: The Process of Faith (ZOOM Video Conference)
summary: Speaking to a group of returned missionaries or scholarship recipients, President Hughes defines the 'powers of heaven' as inspiration, spiritual gifts, priesthood power, expanded intelligence, and physical strength. He explains that while God's love is unconditional, His blessings are heavily conditional upon obedience and righteousness. He then maps out the active process of faith, which demands righteous choices, identifying true/dominant desires, bold and mighty prayer, relentless mental exertion—demonstrated by a powerful letter from Sister Hughes' mother—and practicing pre-emptive gratitude.
